title: Angleton may have pushed MJ-12 as counterintelligence
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Angleton may have pushed MJ-12 as counterintelligence, about decades at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: maybe James Jesus Angleton who was running counter intel for the program for decades actually kind of pushed this

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, wonders aloud whether James Jesus Angleton, who he says ran counterintelligence for the programme for decades, may have pushed the MJ-12 story. MJ-12 refers to documents describing a supposed secret group of top officials handling UFO matters. Michels's idea is that the story could have been spread on purpose to mislead.
